name: PowerDecode
description: PowerDecode is a PowerShell-based tool that allows to deobfuscate PowerShell scripts obfuscated across multiple layers. The tool performs code dynamic analysis, extracting malware hosting URLs and checking http response.It can also detect if the malware attempts to inject shellcode into memory.

name: pe-sieve
description: Scans a given process. Recognizes and dumps a variety of potentially malicious implants (replaced/injected PEs, shellcodes, hooks, in-memory patches).

name: hollows_hunter
description: Scans all running processes. Recognizes and dumps a variety of potentially malicious implants (replaced/implanted PEs, shellcodes, hooks, in-memory patches).

name: pwntools
description: CTF framework and exploit development library

name: exe2shellcode
description: Remote Download and Memory Execute for shellcode framework

name: KittyStager
description: KittyStager is a simple stage 0 C2. It is made of a web server to host the shellcode and an implant, called kitten. The purpose of this project is to be able to have a web server and some kitten and be able to use the with any shellcode.

name: msbuild-shellcode-exec
description: Shellcode execution through msbuild.exe using inline tasks
